summary: GoModel is an AI gateway written in Go that provides a single, OpenAI-compatible API endpoint for multiple large language model providers. It includes built-in cost tracking, usage analytics, budget controls, request guardrails, response caching, and a web-based admin dashboard.
goodFor: Teams managing multiple upstream LLM providers who need centralised cost control, usage monitoring, and routing behind a standardised API interface.
watchOut: As a relatively young project with moderate activity, it may lack the extensive community ecosystem and edge-case testing found in older, more established API gateways.
deployNotes: Being a Go application packaged via Docker, it typically requires persistent storage for analytics data and a standard reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
